title: Photo Desk: from Blake's TV
note: Phone photos of Blake's TV, College Football 27 dynasty and Madden franchise. Captions are short and plain. No em-dashes.

photos.caption: Texas 51, Georgia 7. Texas led 38-0 at halftime.
photos.alt: Final score by quarter: Georgia 7, Texas 51

photos.caption: Lee Iyiegbuniwe was Player of the Game. The A&M receiver caught 3 touchdowns, and A&M beat Texas 41-37.
photos.alt: Player of the Game card for Texas A&M receiver Lee Iyiegbuniwe: 4 catches, 115 yards, 3 touchdowns

photos.caption: Super Bowl LXII: the Patriots lead the Giants 14-0. New England won 21-0.
photos.alt: Patriots on offense against the Giants in Super Bowl LXII, score 14-0

photos.caption: SEC title game, tied 34-34 with 3 seconds left. A&M kicked a field goal and won 37-34.
photos.alt: Texas A&M lines up a field goal with the score tied 34-34 and 3 seconds left

photos.caption: LaShawn Waddy won the 2032 Heisman Trophy. He caught 106 passes for 1,893 yards and 27 touchdowns.
photos.alt: 2032 Heisman Trophy winner screen for receiver LaShawn Waddy

photos.caption: Dion Swayne won the Broyles Award. He was named Coordinator of the Year.
photos.alt: Broyles Award screen for offensive coordinator Dion Swayne

photos.caption: David Keenoy won the Jet Award as the best return man. He had 688 return yards.
photos.alt: 2032 Jet Award screen for running back David Keenoy: 30 returns, 688 yards, 1 touchdown

photos.caption: Vai Fuehne ran an interception back 79 yards for a touchdown. A&M beat Iowa State in the Peach Bowl.
photos.alt: Texas A&M number 7 Vai Fuehne after a 79-yard interception return touchdown

photos.caption: Kameel Cadet caught 3 touchdowns. Clemson beat Pittsburgh in the first round of the playoff.
photos.alt: National Offensive Player of the Week screen for Clemson receiver Kameel Cadet: 6 catches, 140 yards, 3 touchdowns

photos.caption: The Cotton Bowl, set for Clemson and Indiana. Clemson won and moved on.
photos.alt: Wide view of the Cotton Bowl field painted for Clemson and Indiana

photos.caption: Ohio State 14, Ole Miss 10. Ohio State won the Rose Bowl.
photos.alt: Rose Bowl scoreboard at the end of the game: Ole Miss 10, Ohio State 14

photos.caption: Texas A&M 10, Clemson 7. A&M won the Sugar Bowl and went to the title game.
photos.alt: Sugar Bowl final score with the Texas A&M head coach: Texas A&M 10, Clemson 7

photos.caption: Brian Northrop was Player of the Game. Texas beat Ohio State in the Orange Bowl.
photos.alt: Player of the Game card for Texas running back Brian Northrop: 6 carries, 77 yards, 1 touchdown

photos.caption: Texas runs free in the Orange Bowl. Texas beat Ohio State to reach the title game.
photos.alt: Texas number 7 runs alone toward the end zone past two Ohio State players

photos.caption: The national title game: Texas against Texas A&M. It was their third game against each other that season.
photos.alt: Texas and Texas A&M line up on a field painted 2033 for the national title game

photos.caption: Texas quarterback Paul Perkins threw for 49 yards on this play in the title game.
photos.alt: Replay banner: Texas quarterback Paul Perkins, 49 yards gained on a pass

photos.caption: Texas A&M 23, Texas 17. A&M won the national title.
photos.alt: Final score of the national title game: Texas Longhorns 17, Texas A&M Aggies 23
